en.title: Unload the Fewest Boxes to Satisfy a Max-Min Ratio
en.description:
Unload some boxes, keeping at least one, so that the kept sizes satisfy max≤capacity*min. Find the minimum number of boxes unloaded.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n capacity; the second line contains the sizes. The original text gives 1≤n≤100000 and 1≤size≤500000; the range of capacity is missing, and this site specifies a positive integer 1≤capacity≤10^9.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 1, 1 and 0; a ratio exactly equal to the limit is also valid.
hints: Sort, then use two pointers to keep the maximum ≤capacity times the minimum, maximizing the window length.
